# MatOffice

> MatOffice is a self-hosted office suite in the browser: four apps in one – Docs (text documents like Word), Sheets (spreadsheets like Excel), Slides (presentations like PowerPoint) and Base (desktop databases like Access). It opens and saves Word, Excel, PowerPoint and CSV files, keeps versions, and shares documents with people or through a link. Other apps (MatDrive) can open their files in it with an API key. It is a Progressive Web App (installable; the last opened documents stay available offline).

Everything except the start page needs an account or the secret link of a document. The interface is available in English and German.

## What a person can do

- Docs: write on pages (A4 or Letter) with fonts, styles, headings, lists, tables, pictures, links, headers and footers; print or save as PDF; open and save .docx, HTML, Markdown and text.
- Sheets: cells with formulas and functions, formats, several sheets, sorting and filters, charts, frozen rows and columns; open and save .xlsx and .csv.
- Slides: slides with text boxes, shapes, pictures and tables, designs and layouts, speaker notes and a full-screen show; open and save .pptx.
- Base: tables with typed fields, relationships, queries, forms and reports, like a desktop database.
- Keep a version history (snapshots and named versions), restore a version, make copies, star documents, use the trash.
- Share documents with people who have an account (viewer or editor) or through a link.
- Sign in locally or through MatIdentity; mails go through MatSMTP (both optional, set up by Mattiverse).

## For other apps

- `GET /api/v1/host/formats`, `GET /api/v1/host/new`, `POST /api/v1/host/sessions` with `Authorization: Bearer <key of a connected app>`: open a file of the app in the matching editor (WOPI-like; the file is read from and written back to the app).
- The platform contract under /api (health, state, configure, actions) is for Mattiverse and needs a key.
